newsitem.title: THAILAND: National Finance in securities cooperation.
newsitem.headline: National Finance in securities cooperation.

text.p: Thailand's National Finance and Securities Plc said on Monday it had signed a cooperation agreement with U.S. investment bank Bear, Sterns & Co, Inc.
In a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand, National Finance said its agreement with Bear Sterns had been approved by the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Under the agreement, Bear Stearns will provide research assistance and cooperation to National Finance.
Bear Stearns will also will help National Finance expand their securities business in international markets, it said.
